title: OL-20261115-18: workers#73 Self-start loop: org/started.json
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** self-start schedule
**Done check:** file:org/started.json
**Status:** closed

Moved from ultrastable/workers#73. The self-start workflow re-checks every 6 hours and stays in dry run until a door in workers#75 exists, then records org/started.json. Probe file_exists:org/started.json.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 156.4 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
